summary: Pass. L1 packing now preserves the head and tail of long symbols instead of cutting off mid-function.
evidence: src/capsule/packer.ts:14-35 implements `renderL1SmartTruncation`, keeping the first 60% and final 40% of visible lines and inserting an omitted-lines marker with a `cw_read` hint.
